_README: Label id -> structure name for the Visible Human FEMALE pectoralis minor / rhomboid volume (scripts/cryo/vhf_pecminor_rhomboids.py: the male's position rules on her registered cryosection photographs, anchored on her model pectoralis major, trapezius, scapula, rib and vertebra labels), plus the mapping onto atlas entities.
A KEY, not data. Rule-based; pectoralis minor over-inclusive on the male; rhomboid major and minor as one mass; badge it.
v3 with the female colour classes and the thoracic-cage convex hull: pectoralis minor shipped (42 / 31 cm3), rhomboids not.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), female cryosections and CT via the NCI Imaging Data Commons; TotalSegmentator v2.18.0 labels as anchors.

rhomboid_right.note: On her the rhomboid rule finds 49 / 32 cm3 of patches (female 70-110), paraspinal rather than the sheet; not shipped (2026-09-12).
